fields.v: (1) AI-SDLC v1.0.0-beta + coding agent not stated + model not stated (student projects, survey n=13). Criterion: none stated by the authors (descriptive, exploratory survey of student perceptions). Values: Specify sharpened requirements 13/13 agree (11 strongly); structured collaboration 12/13; phases gave orientation 12/13; improved quality 10/13; faster progress 13/13; would reuse 12/13; overhead in some phases 4/13; adopted code without understanding 6/13 (closed item), 11/13 (free text); following the code lowest-rated positive item; PR review ~half; NPS median 8. Quality verdict: no criterion stated by the authors. Cost verdict: no criterion stated by the authors
fields.quote: Since the study covers one cohort at one point in time and has no control group, it is descriptive and exploratory and is not designed to establish causal effects.
fields.why: The authors state no success criterion, so under the 2026-11-23 rule the quality and cost verdicts must be 'no criterion stated by the authors', not 'partly'.
fields.doubt: Os autores não definem nenhum critério de sucesso; o estudo é descritivo e exploratório (pág. 4). Pela regra de 23-11, sem critério dos autores o veredicto de qualidade e de custo é "no criterion stated by the authors", não "partly". Mantém os valores e troca os dois veredictos.
